# Taliferro

> Taliferro (Taliferro Group) is a Seattle-based IT consulting and advisory firm. It helps businesses find the bottleneck holding them back and fixes it directly: cloud architecture, AI/ML, software development, API design, agile delivery, and technology leadership.

taliferro.com covers consulting and advisory work only. Taliferro's software products (including TODD) are covered at https://taliferro.tech, not on this site.

## Consulting and advisory

- [Services](https://taliferro.com/services/): full list of consulting services
- [Rescue Me](https://taliferro.com/rescue-me/): flat-fee IT rescue engagement with a written diagnosis
- [Fractional CTO](https://taliferro.com/fractional-cto/): on-demand technology leadership
- [Cloud architecture consulting](https://taliferro.com/cloud-architecture-consulting/): AWS, Azure, and GCP
- [Machine learning and AI consulting](https://taliferro.com/machine-learning-services/)
- [API design and integration](https://taliferro.com/api-design-services/)
- [API security certification](https://taliferro.com/api-certification/)
- [Agile coaching](https://taliferro.com/agile-coaching/)
- [Website development](https://taliferro.com/website-development/)
- [E-commerce development](https://taliferro.com/ecommerce-development/)
- [IT consultant, Seattle](https://taliferro.com/it-consultant-seattle/)
- [Small business IT consultant](https://taliferro.com/small-business-it-consultant/)
- [Case studies](https://taliferro.com/case-studies.html): client results
